caption: This shoyu ramen features a rich, amber broth with tender chashu pork and crisp menma. Topped with shredded cabbage and nori, it sits in a white bowl on a wooden table, bathed in warm, natural light.

segments_info.text: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle texture, appearing smooth and slightly reflective.
The chashu pork has a glistening, caramelized surface with visible fat marbling and a slightly uneven, irregular shape.
The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, irregularly shaped, and has a slightly rough, uneven surface.
The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is amber-brown, glossy, and contains visible noodles and shredded white toppings.
Menma bamboo shoots appear as golden-brown, slightly translucent, elongated strips with a fibrous texture.
White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, rounded rim.
A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved, tapered shape.
